title: CZ Registration No. verification must do integrity and schema check of the response
summary: The CZ Registration No. validation against the ARES Czech business register now includes schema, integrity, and size checks before marking responses as Valid, similar to other unauthenticated integrations.
key_points: Schema validation ensures responses contain required fields (ico, obchodniJmeno, sidlo) as non-empty strings or objects
Integrity check confirms the response ico exactly matches the requested IČO
Response body is capped at 64 KB and validated before JSON parsing
Invalid responses are rejected with Security Audit and telemetry entries
Prevents acceptance of malformed or unrelated ARES data for master data updates
quote: the response must contain the fields ARES returns for every economic subject
